name: Dr. Andrea Hemmerich
title: Co-Founder @ Up4 The Challenge; Adjunct Assistant Professor @ Queen's and McMaster Universities
bio: Dr. Andrea Hemmerich (PhD, Biomedical Engineering) is an Adjunct Assistant Professor at Queen's University and in the W Booth School of Engineering Practice and Technology at McMaster University, where she teaches Design Thinking. Her research extends across engineering, health and wellness, education, and international development fields, and has included maternal health studies and water, sanitation and hygiene (WaSH) system design in Africa and South Asia. She received an NSERC Postdoctoral Fellowship for pioneering research on upright maternal positioning in childbirth. Andrea is committed to advancing equity-based approaches to science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM) education. As Co-Founder of Up4 The Challenge, an award-winning non-profit promoting STEM for social impact, she co-designs and delivers inclusive, experiential learning programs for underserved youth across Canada. Andrea's priorities are to create opportunities for social change through a human-centred approach to design and innovation.
